messages:
Priya (Design): Quick design review sync on Autoscale controls. Loom with new flows posted. High level asks: clarify SLO slider states (Off / Preset / Custom), make Burst more discoverable when pool cards are dense, and fix keyboard focus order for pool picker -> burst toggle. Keeping copy concise. Noah (Frontend): Sounds good. Two constraints: moving Burst out of the card increases vertical height; keyboard order follows DOM so we'll likely reorder elements. I can mock a compact floating Burst affordance. Ava (A11Y): +1 for keyboard-first. A11y notes: burst pill contrast currently ~3.8:1, needs 4.5:1 for normal text; SLO slider should announce state via aria-valuetext (e.g., "SLO target 250ms, custom"); preset buttons need aria-pressed. Also visible focus ring required. Sam (PM): Defaults must be cost-safe. Set default SLO to conservative min/max to avoid runaway burst. Add an inline guardrail hint when burst >50% explaining cost/latency tradeoffs. We should also soft-nudge if selected pool lacks capacity for chosen SLO. Jae (Eng): Implementation notes: burst maps to burst_quota in the API. If the affordance floats, ensure it still ties to the selected pool id. Suggest backend treat presets as named profiles (preset_id) to avoid frequent migrations. Edge case: cap burst_quota at pool_max and show warning. Priya (Design): Proposed SLO slider visuals: Off = ghosted thumb + "Disabled" label; Preset = filled track + small chip with preset name; Custom = filled track + numeric readout. Microcopy: change "Burst" -> "Burst capacity" with tooltip "Temporary extra GPUs for spikes (billed while active)". Move Burst to right side of pool row as compact toggle with ? icon. Noah (Frontend): For aria I can add: role="slider" aria-valuemin="50" aria-valuemax="300" aria-valuenow="250" aria-valuetext="SLO target 250ms". Example inline:
Ava (A11Y): That helps. Ensure the burst toggle is reachable with a single Tab from the pool picker. Avoid visual-only reordering; DOM order must match keyboard order. Sam (PM): UX decision: when pool capacity < SLO need, show soft nudge: "This SLO may need more capacity — view options" (less alarming) with a cost compare modal. Do not auto-upgrade. Jae (Eng): Agreed. We'll use the cost-estimator API to surface estimated monthly delta for SLO/pool combos. Also enforce burst_quota <= pool_max at submission and display inline warning. Priya (Design): I'll update FigJam frames and add an a11y checklist: contrast fix, aria-valuetext examples, focus order. Also include copy variants for the nudge: (A) "This SLO may need more capacity — view options" vs (B) "SLO exceeds pool capacity — explore upgrade." Team pick? Sam (PM): Pick A. Less scary. Noah (Frontend): I'll prototype floating burst pill and revised DOM order tomorrow, ship behind feature flag to staging if all good. deploy-bot: deploy/ui-staging v2.16.2 succeeded — https://staging.redwood.dev/deploys/4299 Priya (Design): Thanks all — I'll push updated frames and call a 15min usability pass once the prototype is up. :rocket:
